reasoning: On the season so far the Raptors are the stronger team; with home court the Raptors start about 7 points better, in a game of about 227 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Raptors.
The mental side leans about 1 point towards the Raptors (look-ahead).
Bottom line: the Raptors win 74 times in 100, by about 8; most games like this end between 199 and 247 total points.
